Front: 1. NaNH2, NH3; 2. RCH2Br (1° alkyl halide or CH3X) (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Alkylation of acetylide anions (acetylide-alkylation) — Family: substitution (SN2 by acetylide anion) | Stereo: inversion at the electrophilic carbon (SN2 mechanism)
Why: Intermediate：acetylide anion ($\text{RC}\equiv\text{C:}^-\text{Na}^+$)

Front: 1. NaNH2, NH3; 2. RCH2Br (1° alkyl halide or CH3X) (Alkylation of acetylide anions) 的 regio / 選擇性？
Back: C–C bond forms at the terminal sp carbon and the primary carbon bearing the leaving group
Why: Alkylation of acetylide anions — Intermediate: acetylide anion ($\text{RC}\equiv\text{C:}^-\text{Na}^+$) (substitution (SN2 by acetylide anion))

Front: 1. NaNH2, NH3; 2. RCH2Br (1° alkyl halide or CH3X) (Alkylation of acetylide anions) 的立體化學 (stereo)？
Back: inversion at the electrophilic carbon (SN2 mechanism)
Why: Family: substitution (SN2 by acetylide anion)；Intermediate: acetylide anion ($\text{RC}\equiv\text{C:}^-\text{Na}^+$)

Front: 對比：`acetylide-alkylation` 對 `1° alkyl halide` vs `2°/3° alkyl halide` 的反應差異？
Back: 1° vs 2°/3° alkyl halides：由於 acetylide anion 同時也是強鹼，**僅限使用甲基或一級鹵代烷 ($\text{CH}_3\text{X}, \text{RCH}_2\text{X}$)** 才能走 $\text{S}_\text{N}2$；若遇到二級或三級鹵代烷，會改走 **E2 消去反應**生成烯類！
Why: Alkylation of acetylide anions: intermediate = acetylide anion ($\text{RC}\equiv\text{C:}^-\text{Na}^+$), regio = C–C bond forms at the terminal sp carbon and the primary carbon bearing the leaving group, stereo = inversion at the electrophilic carbon (SN2 mechanism)

Front: 預測產物：1-hexyne + 1. NaNH2, NH3; 2. CH3Br → ?
Back: 2-heptyne
Why:
Deprotonation of terminal alkyne (pKa ~ 25) gives acetylide anion → SN2 on 1°/methyl halide
SMILESCCCCC#CC

Front: 預測產物：propyne + 1. NaNH2, NH3; 2. 2-bromopropane → ?
Back: propene + propyne (E2 elimination, NOT alkylation!)
Why:
2° and 3° alkyl halides undergo E2 elimination with strongly basic acetylide anions instead of SN2
SMILESCC=C

Front: NaNH2, NH3（或 RLi 等 pKa(共軛酸) > 25 的強鹼） (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Conversion into acetylide anions (acetylide-deprotonation) — Family: acid-base (deprotonation of terminal alkyne) | Stereo: n/a
Why: Intermediate：acetylide anion ($\text{R-C}\equiv\text{C:}^-\text{Na}^+$)

Front: NaNH2, NH3（或 RLi 等 pKa(共軛酸) > 25 的強鹼） (Conversion into acetylide anions) 的 regio / 選擇性？
Back: selective for terminal acetylenic H ($\equiv\text{C-H}$) only
Why: Conversion into acetylide anions — Intermediate: acetylide anion ($\text{R-C}\equiv\text{C:}^-\text{Na}^+$) (acid-base (deprotonation of terminal alkyne))

Front: 對比：為什麼去質子化末端炔要用 `NaNH2` 或 `BuLi`，而不能用 `KOH` / `NaOH`？
Back: vs KOH / NaOH：$\text{OH}^-$ 的共軛酸 $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ ($\text{p}K_\text{a} = 15.7$) 酸性比末端炔 ($\text{p}K_\text{a} = 25$) 強太多，因此 `KOH` / `NaOH` **無法**將末端炔去質子化；必須使用 `NaNH2` 或 `BuLi`。
Why: Conversion into acetylide anions: intermediate = acetylide anion ($\text{R-C}\equiv\text{C:}^-\text{Na}^+$), regio = selective for terminal acetylenic H ($\equiv\text{C-H}$) only, stereo = n/a

Front: 預測產物：1-butyne + NaNH2, NH3 → ?
Back: sodium butynylde (CH3CH2C≡C⁻Na⁺) + NH3
Why: Conversion into acetylide anions: regio=selective for terminal acetylenic H ($\equiv\text{C-H}$) only, stereo=n/a

Front: KMnO4, H3O⁺ 或 1. O3; 2. H2O (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Oxidative cleavage of alkynes (alkyne-cleavage) — Family: cleavage (oxidative cleavage to carboxylic acids / CO2) | Stereo: n/a
Why: Intermediate：α-diketone / ozonide intermediate (cleaved under reaction conditions)

Front: 對比：炔類氧化斷裂 (`KMnO4` or `O3`) 與烯類臭氧化 (`O3; Zn`) 的產物差異？
Back: vs alkene ozonolysis：烯類（alkene）經臭氧化還原（`O3; Zn`）會得到**醛／酮**；而炔類（alkyne）不論用 `O3` 或 `KMnO4` 氧化斷裂，都會直接得到**羧酸（carboxylic acids）**（末端 $\equiv\text{CH}$ 則變 $\text{CO}_2$）。
Why: Oxidative cleavage of alkynes: intermediate = α-diketone / ozonide intermediate (cleaved under reaction conditions), regio = n/a, stereo = n/a

Front: 預測產物：1-butyne + KMnO4, H3O⁺ (or O3; H2O) → ?
Back: propanoic acid (CH3CH2CO2H) + CO2
Why:
Oxidative cleavage converts internal ≡C–R to RCO2H and terminal ≡CH to CO2
SMILESCCC(=O)O

Front: 預測產物：2-hexyne + KMnO4, H3O⁺ → ?
Back: acetic acid (CH3CO2H) + butanoic acid (CH3CH2CH2CO2H)
Why: Oxidative cleavage of alkynes: regio=n/a, stereo=n/a

Front: 2 KOH, ethanol 或 2 NaNH2, NH3（由 vicinal dihalide 出發；若由 vinylic halide 出發則需 1 equiv） (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Dehydrohalogenation of vicinal dihalides (dehydrohalogenation) — Family: elimination (twofold E2 elimination) | Stereo: n/a (linear sp-hybridized alkyne product; 2nd E2 prefers anti-periplanar H and X)
Why: Intermediate：vinylic halide (after 1st E2 elimination)

Front: 2 KOH, ethanol 或 2 NaNH2, NH3（由 vicinal dihalide 出發；若由 vinylic halide 出發則需 1 equiv） (Dehydrohalogenation of vicinal dihalides) 的 regio / 選擇性？
Back: forms triple bond between the two halogen-bearing carbons
Why: Dehydrohalogenation of vicinal dihalides — Intermediate: vinylic halide (after 1st E2 elimination) (elimination (twofold E2 elimination))

Front: 預測產物：1,2-dibromohexane + 2 NaNH2, NH3; then H3O⁺ → ?
Back: 1-hexyne
Why:
Twofold E2 elimination of vicinal dibromide yields terminal alkyne after protonation
SMILESCCCCC#C

Front: Li (or Na), NH3(l) (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Lithium in liquid ammonia reduction (Dissolving metal) (dissolving-metal-reduction) — Family: anti (radical anion → trans-vinylic radical → trans-vinylic anion → trans-alkene) | Stereo: anti (yields trans / (E)-alkene)
Why: Intermediate：radical anion → vinylic radical → trans-vinylic anion (both radical and polar steps!)

Front: Li (or Na), NH3(l) (Lithium in liquid ammonia reduction (Dissolving metal)) 的 regio / 選擇性？
Back: selective for internal triple bond (terminal alkynes may be deprotonated unless excess metal/NH3 is used)
Why: Lithium in liquid ammonia reduction (Dissolving metal) — Intermediate: radical anion → vinylic radical → trans-vinylic anion (both radical and polar steps!) (anti (radical anion → trans-vinylic radical → trans-vinylic anion → trans-alkene))

Front: Li (or Na), NH3(l) (Lithium in liquid ammonia reduction (Dissolving metal)) 的立體化學 (stereo)？
Back: anti (yields trans / (E)-alkene)
Why: Family: anti (radical anion → trans-vinylic radical → trans-vinylic anion → trans-alkene)；Intermediate: radical anion → vinylic radical → trans-vinylic anion (both radical and polar steps!)

Front: 預測產物：5-decyne + Li, NH3 → ?
Back: trans-5-decene
Why:
Dissolving metal reduction proceeds via trans-vinylic radical/anion to give trans-alkene
SMILESCCCC/C=C/CCCC

Front: 預測產物：3-hexyne + Li, ND3 → ?
Back: (E)-3,4-dideuterio-3-hexene
Why: Lithium in liquid ammonia reduction (Dissolving metal): regio=selective for internal triple bond (terminal alkynes may be deprotonated unless excess metal/NH3 is used), stereo=anti (yields trans / (E)-alkene)

Front: H2SO4, H2O, HgSO4 (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Mercuric sulfate-catalyzed hydration of alkynes (hgso4-hydration) — Family: anti (mercurinium-type hydration → enol → ketone tautomerization) | Stereo: n/a (enol tautomerizes to achiral/planar carbonyl C=O)
Why: Intermediate：organomercury enol → enol ($\text{R-C(OH)=CH}_2$) → tautomerizes to ketone

Front: H2SO4, H2O, HgSO4 (Mercuric sulfate-catalyzed hydration of alkynes) 的 regio / 選擇性？
Back: Markovnikov (terminal alkyne always yields a methyl ketone, RCOCH3)
Why: Mercuric sulfate-catalyzed hydration of alkynes — Intermediate: organomercury enol → enol ($\text{R-C(OH)=CH}_2$) → tautomerizes to ketone (anti (mercurinium-type hydration → enol → ketone tautomerization))

Front: 對比：末端炔經 `H2SO4, H2O, HgSO4` vs `1. BH3; 2. H2O2, OH⁻` 的水合產物差異？
Back: vs hydroboration-alkyne：末端炔經 `H2SO4, H2O, HgSO4` 為 **Markovnikov** 水合，得到**甲基酮（methyl ketone, $\text{RCOCH}_3$）**；若經 `1. BH3; 2. H2O2, OH⁻` 則為 **anti-Markovnikov** 水合，得到**醛（aldehyde, $\text{RCH}_2\text{CHO}$）**。
Why: Mercuric sulfate-catalyzed hydration of alkynes: intermediate = organomercury enol → enol ($\text{R-C(OH)=CH}_2$) → tautomerizes to ketone, regio = Markovnikov (terminal alkyne always yields a methyl ketone, RCOCH3), stereo = n/a (enol tautomerizes to achiral/planar carbonyl C=O)

Front: 預測產物：1-hexyne + H2O, H2SO4, HgSO4 → ?
Back: 2-hexanone (methyl ketone)
Why:
Markovnikov hydration gives internal enol, which rapidly tautomerizes to methyl ketone
SMILESCCCCC(=O)C

Front: 預測產物：2-hexyne + H2O, H2SO4, HgSO4 → ?
Back: mixture of 2-hexanone and 3-hexanone (unsymmetrical internal alkyne)
Why: Mercuric sulfate-catalyzed hydration of alkynes: regio=Markovnikov (terminal alkyne always yields a methyl ketone, RCOCH3), stereo=n/a (enol tautomerizes to achiral/planar carbonyl C=O)

Front: HX (HCl, HBr, HI), ether（1 equiv 得 vinylic halide；2 equiv 得 geminal dihalide） (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Addition of HCl and HBr to alkynes (hx-addition-alkyne) — Family: cation (vinylic cation / Markovnikov addition) | Stereo: usually trans (anti) for 1st equiv addition
Why: Intermediate：vinylic carbocation (1st equiv) → halo-substituted carbocation stabilized by halogen lone pair resonance (2nd equiv)

Front: HX (HCl, HBr, HI), ether（1 equiv 得 vinylic halide；2 equiv 得 geminal dihalide） (Addition of HCl and HBr to alkynes) 的 regio / 選擇性？
Back: Markovnikov (1 equiv → X on more substituted C; 2 equiv → both X on the SAME carbon = geminal dihalide)
Why: Addition of HCl and HBr to alkynes — Intermediate: vinylic carbocation (1st equiv) → halo-substituted carbocation stabilized by halogen lone pair resonance (2nd equiv) (cation (vinylic cation / Markovnikov addition))

Front: 對比：炔類加 `1 equiv HX` vs `2 equiv HX` 的產物差異與原因？
Back: 1 equiv vs 2 equiv HX：第 1 當量生成 vinylic halide；第 2 當量加成時，因為鹵素孤對電子可透過共振穩定鄰近碳陽離子（$\text{R}-\stackrel{+}{\text{C}}(\text{X})-\text{CH}_3 \leftrightarrow \text{R}-\text{C}(=\stackrel{+}{\text{X}})-\text{CH}_3$），第二個 X 必接在**同一個碳**上，生成 **geminal dihalide（偕二鹵代烷）**！
Why: Addition of HCl and HBr to alkynes: intermediate = vinylic carbocation (1st equiv) → halo-substituted carbocation stabilized by halogen lone pair resonance (2nd equiv), regio = Markovnikov (1 equiv → X on more substituted C; 2 equiv → both X on the SAME carbon = geminal dihalide), stereo = usually trans (anti) for 1st equiv addition

Front: 預測產物：1-hexyne + 1 equiv HBr → ?
Back: 2-bromo-1-hexene
Why:
Markovnikov addition places Br on the more substituted internal sp carbon
SMILESCCCCC(Br)=C

Front: 預測產物：1-hexyne + 2 equiv HCl → ?
Back: 2,2-dichlorohexane (geminal dihalide)
Why:
Second Markovnikov addition is directed to the same carbon by lone-pair resonance stabilization from the first Cl
SMILESCCCCC(Cl)(Cl)C

Front: 1. BH3, THF (or bulky R2BH such as Sia2BH / 9-BBN); 2. H2O2, OH⁻ (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Hydroboration–oxidation of alkynes (hydroboration-alkyne) — Family: syn (concerted syn hydration → enol → carbonyl tautomerization) | Stereo: syn in the hydroboration step (stereochemistry lost upon tautomerization to aldehyde/ketone)
Why: Intermediate：vinylic borane → enol ($\text{R-CH=CH-OH}$) → tautomerizes to aldehyde (or ketone for internal alkyne)

Front: 1. BH3, THF (or bulky R2BH such as Sia2BH / 9-BBN); 2. H2O2, OH⁻ (Hydroboration–oxidation of alkynes) 的 regio / 選擇性？
Back: anti-Markovnikov (OH adds to the less sterically hindered terminal sp carbon → terminal alkyne yields an aldehyde!)
Why: Hydroboration–oxidation of alkynes — Intermediate: vinylic borane → enol ($\text{R-CH=CH-OH}$) → tautomerizes to aldehyde (or ketone for internal alkyne) (syn (concerted syn hydration → enol → carbonyl tautomerization))

Front: 預測產物：1-butyne + 1. BH3, THF; 2. H2O2, OH⁻ → ?
Back: butanal (CH3CH2CH2CHO)
Why:
anti-Markovnikov hydration gives terminal enol, which tautomerizes to aldehyde
SMILESCCCC=O

Front: 預測產物：5-decyne + 1. BH3, THF; 2. H2O2, OH⁻ → ?
Back: 5-decanone
Why: Hydroboration–oxidation of alkynes: regio=anti-Markovnikov (OH adds to the less sterically hindered terminal sp carbon → terminal alkyne yields an aldehyde!), stereo=syn in the hydroboration step (stereochemistry lost upon tautomerization to aldehyde/ketone)

Front: 2 H2 (excess H2), Pd/C (or PtO2) (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Complete catalytic hydrogenation of alkynes (hydrogenation-complete) — Family: syn (complete reduction to alkane) | Stereo: syn (both steps, though achiral alkane usually results from simple alkynes)
Why: Intermediate：cis-alkene intermediate (rapidly hydrogenated further to alkane)

Front: 對比：`2 H2, Pd/C` vs `H2, Lindlar catalyst` 對炔類的還原程度差異？
Back: vs lindlar-reduction：`2 H2, Pd/C` 活性太強，無法停在烯類階段，會一路還原到底變成 **alkane**；若要停在 *cis*-alkene，必須使用經毒化鈍化的 **Lindlar catalyst**。
Why: Complete catalytic hydrogenation of alkynes: intermediate = cis-alkene intermediate (rapidly hydrogenated further to alkane), regio = n/a, stereo = syn (both steps, though achiral alkane usually results from simple alkynes)

Front: 預測產物：5-decyne + 2 H2, Pd/C → ?
Back: decane
Why: Complete catalytic hydrogenation of alkynes: regio=n/a, stereo=syn (both steps, though achiral alkane usually results from simple alkynes)

Front: H2, Lindlar catalyst（$\text{Pd/CaCO}_3$ 經 $\text{Pb(OAc)}_2$ 與 quinoline 毒化鈍化） (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Partial catalytic hydrogenation (Lindlar catalyst) (lindlar-reduction) — Family: syn (concerted syn reduction to cis-alkene) | Stereo: syn (yields cis / (Z)-alkene)
Why: Intermediate：none (concerted addition on poisoned catalyst surface)

Front: H2, Lindlar catalyst（$\text{Pd/CaCO}_3$ 經 $\text{Pb(OAc)}_2$ 與 quinoline 毒化鈍化） (Partial catalytic hydrogenation (Lindlar catalyst)) 的 regio / 選擇性？
Back: selective for triple bond ($\text{C}\equiv\text{C}$) over double bond ($\text{C=C}$)
Why: Partial catalytic hydrogenation (Lindlar catalyst) — Intermediate: none (concerted addition on poisoned catalyst surface) (syn (concerted syn reduction to cis-alkene))

Front: H2, Lindlar catalyst（$\text{Pd/CaCO}_3$ 經 $\text{Pb(OAc)}_2$ 與 quinoline 毒化鈍化） (Partial catalytic hydrogenation (Lindlar catalyst)) 的立體化學 (stereo)？
Back: syn (yields cis / (Z)-alkene)
Why: Family: syn (concerted syn reduction to cis-alkene)；Intermediate: none (concerted addition on poisoned catalyst surface)

Front: 對比：`H2, Lindlar catalyst` vs `Li, NH3(l)` 還原內部炔的立體化學差異？
Back: vs dissolving-metal-reduction (`Li, NH3`)：`H2, Lindlar catalyst` 為 **syn** 還原，將內部炔轉為 **cis-alkene**；`Li, NH3` 為 **anti** 還原（經由 vinylic radical 與 vinylic anion），將內部炔轉為 **trans-alkene**。
Why: Partial catalytic hydrogenation (Lindlar catalyst): intermediate = none (concerted addition on poisoned catalyst surface), regio = selective for triple bond ($\text{C}\equiv\text{C}$) over double bond ($\text{C=C}$), stereo = syn (yields cis / (Z)-alkene)

Front: 預測產物：5-decyne + H2, Lindlar catalyst → ?
Back: cis-5-decene
Why:
Concerted syn hydrogenation on poisoned Pd catalyst stops at cis-alkene
SMILESCCCC/C=C\CCCC

Front: Cl2 or Br2, CH2Cl2（1 equiv 得 trans-1,2-dihaloalkene；2 equiv 得 1,1,2,2-tetrahalide） (Ch09 Alkynes) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Addition of Cl2 and Br2 to alkynes (x2-addition-alkyne) — Family: anti (three-membered ring opened by back-side attack) | Stereo: anti (1 equiv gives trans / (E)-1,2-dihaloalkene)
Why: Intermediate：bridged halirenium ion (vinylic halonium ion)

Front: Cl2 or Br2, CH2Cl2（1 equiv 得 trans-1,2-dihaloalkene；2 equiv 得 1,1,2,2-tetrahalide） (Addition of Cl2 and Br2 to alkynes) 的立體化學 (stereo)？
Back: anti (1 equiv gives trans / (E)-1,2-dihaloalkene)
Why: Family: anti (three-membered ring opened by back-side attack)；Intermediate: bridged halirenium ion (vinylic halonium ion)

Front: 預測產物：1-hexyne + 1 equiv Cl2 → ?
Back: (E)-1,2-dichloro-1-hexene
Why:
anti addition of Cl2 across triple bond gives trans-1,2-dichloroalkene
SMILESCCCC/C(Cl)=C(\H)Cl

Front: 預測產物：2-butyne + 2 equiv Br2 → ?
Back: 2,2,3,3-tetrabromobutane
Why:
Twofold halogen addition across triple bond yields tetrahalide
SMILESCC(Br)(Br)C(C)(Br)Br
